description: This file provides high-level API functions for configuring and retrieving user-defined field selectors in the RTL8367C switch hardware, specifically within the High-Speed Buffer (HSB) module. It includes functions to set and get field selector configurations, including parameters such as format and data offset.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 format,rtk_uint32 offset)
methods.description: Configures a specific field selector in the RTL8367C hardware by setting its format and offset parameters based on index.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pFormat,rtk_uint32 * pOffset)
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of a specific field selector, including its format and offset.

ctags.name: rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector
ctags.pattern: /^ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index, rtk_uint32* pFormat, rtk_uint32* pOffset)$/

ctags.name: rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector
ctags.pattern: /^ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index, rtk_uint32 format, rtk_uint32 offset)$/
